proposals.title: Write ADR for hash function (DEFINIR: ADR-002)
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 is TRAVADA and requires the hash function to be 'especificada bit a bit em ADR, e não pode ser a função de hash nativa'. This is an explicit DEFINIR item listed in §19 lacunas conhecidas. Without the ADR, rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) cannot be implemented correctly, which blocks the positional RNG and in turn the entire world simulation. The ADR must be written before the implementation so reviewers can verify correctness bit-by-bit.

proposals.why_now: FASE-1 scope explicitly requires 'Gerador de preço com duas camadas de ruído e dois ativos'. This is the minimum world simulation needed to drive the tick loop, the ledger, and the minimal UI (chart, balance). It depends on core arithmetic types (IDEA-002) and the positional RNG (IDEA-004). Once core is complete, this is the next architectural blocker on the critical path to a testable end-to-end loop.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo scaffold only: 8 package stubs (all src/index.ts export {}), 4 desktop sub-app stubs, 3 tool stubs, CI pipeline, lint rules, boundary checker, and test fixtures are committed. Zero ADR documents exist in docs/decisions/. Zero production code exists in any package. The only accepted task (TASK-0002) delivered the scaffold itself. TASK-0007 (ADR-009 + CanonicalEncoder) has been rejected three consecutive times.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: The CanonicalEncoder (TASK-0007) has been rejected three times. The two remaining MAJOR findings are: (1) non-enumerable own properties on plain objects are silently discarded instead of rejected, allowing distinct admitted states to share bytes and breaking the injectivity claim of ADR-009 and INV-22; (2) npm run compile was not executed and its exit code not independently captured. Until these are resolved and the encoder is committed, no StateHash, SaveHash, or any hash-dependent work can begin.

warnings: TASK-0007 process risk: the encoder has been rejected three consecutive times. The fourth attempt must be narrowly scoped to exactly the two MAJOR findings from review-03 (non-enumerable property rejection and captured compile output) without introducing new surface area or refactoring unrelated encoding logic.

Zero ADR documents exist in docs/decisions/ despite the spec requiring several DEFINIR items to be resolved by ADR before implementation. The hash function ADR (ADR-002 DEFINIR) and the octave-parameter configuration (§5.1 DEFINIR) are prerequisites for implementing rand() and the price generator respectively. Implementing these without prior ADRs will reproduce the same review-cycle pattern seen in TASK-0007.

The spec states at §14.6: 'o instalador existe na FASE-1, em forma mínima'. No Electron, preload, renderer, or packaging work has been started. While core arithmetic and the encoder are higher priority now, the installer requirement must not be deferred to the end of FASE-1 or it risks the same last-week ABI/packaging failures the spec explicitly warns against.
